body.name: encH
body.def: \(\operatorname{enc}_H(\zeta)\) concatenates, in the fixed topological, context, vertex, district, and response-row orders, every unfinished task graph and mask, every labelled rational kernel, the freshly scanned gate agenda, the constraint and positivity ledgers, the accumulated circuit, the residual candidate lists, and the terminal marker. All component alphabets and lists are finite.
